verdict.rationale: Clerky documents a change-log/audit feature ("We log every change anyone makes to a document set or workspace, so you can always see who was responsible for what"), which supports an audit-trail claim, but there is no evidence of a tamper-evident mechanism (e.g., cryptographic sealing, hash verification) or of a completion certificate issued upon signing. Missing for 10: tamper-evidence proof (cryptographic/hash-based integrity), explicit completion certificate documentation, and independent verification of audit log robustness.
